Name: Ginger Island Extra Locations Redux - 1.6 Compatibility Hot Patch
Author: ktiedt
Description:
[size=6][b]Ginger Island Extra Locations Redux - 1.6 Compatibility Hot Patch[/b][/size]

[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
This is a lightweight runtime compatibility patch for mistyspring's [b]Ginger Island Extra Locations - Redux[/b] mod. While the original mod added incredible new areas, animals, and items to Ginger Island, its transition to Stardew Valley 1.6 introduced multiple runtime crashes, broken menus, and missing shop inventory.

This mod runs alongside the parent mod and applies Harmony hooks and asset hotfixes at runtime to restore 1.0.0 functionality seamlessly without altering the original files.

[line]

[size=5][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Shop Inventory Fixes[/b]: Fixes a bug where custom tools ([font=Courier New]HugeBanana[/font], [font=Courier New]HugeCoconut[/font], [font=Courier New]HugeMango[/font], magic dusts, and [font=Courier New]StarDropSeeds[/font]) were completely missing from the Island Animal Shop. The mod intercepts the shop assets at runtime to properly register these items using 1.6's tool-handling format.[/*]
[*][b]Volcano Elevator & Controller Fix[/b]: Resolves black-screen hangs and game freezes when interacting with the custom volcano elevator, adding full controller navigation support.[/*]
[*][b]Crop & Season Logic[/b]: Corrects issues where custom crops were not recognized as harvestable, out-of-season, or crashed when interacted with on Ginger Island.[/*]
[*][b]Recipe Learning & Legacy Migration[/b]: Fixes recipe purchases failing to unlock in the crafting log, and automatically migrates legacy 1.5 recipe placeholders to their 1.6 equivalents on the fly when loading a save file.[/*]
[*][b]Animal Sprite Heights[/b]: Automatically extends animal sprite layouts (such as the Void Goat) to prevent SMAPI from cropping or rendering them invisible in barn environments.[/*]
[*]Custom Fish and Minerals are now appropriately tracked in the stats panels as expected.[/*]
[*]Banana Cows and Void Dinosaurs produce the appropriately modified animal product.[/*]
[*]RustyWheel artifact is properly registered. -- Unfortunately, this artifact was never properly implemented at all - while its registered, it has no artwork and that is beyond the scope of simply hot patching broken code.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
To use this patch, you must have the following installed:
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (v1.6 or newer)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (v4.0 or newer)[/*]
[*][b]Ginger Island Extra Locations - redux[/b] (by mistyspring)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Copy the [font=Courier New]GiEXReduxPatch[/font] folder into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder (usually located at [font=Courier New]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/font]).[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Shout Outs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]mistyspring[/b] for creating the original [i]Ginger Island Extra Locations - Redux[/i] mod and mapping out these fantastic island additions.[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley modding community and the creators of SMAPI for their invaluable documentation and tools.[/*]
[/list]
